items:
* Close to 30A
* Walk to the beach
* Walk to nearby Seaside, dining and shopping
* Plenty of parking - bring your RV (30-amp hook-up) and boat
* Great wrap-around porch with plenty of seating
* Beach wagon, four backpack beach chairs, and umbrella
* Fully stocked kitchen
* Ample seating in the dining and living rooms

Walk to the beach, Seaside, dining, and shopping! This cottage is located in Old Seagrove and close to 30A. There is plenty of parking and this vacation rental has an RV Hook-up (30-amp) and boat parking! Seagrove Sanctuary has proven to be a guest favorite and will provide complete relaxation on two oversized porches to start your day enjoying a morning coffee or day-end cocktails and conversations. There are two swings to enjoy nature’s symphony from the secluded, screened-in comfort of the wrap-around porch.

The outside of this conveniently located home off 30A will remind you of Old Florida in its architecture, but the updates inside are the perfect touch! This beauty sleeps six, with two queen bedrooms, complete with TVs and a sleeper sofa in the main area. Guests will find the parking and camper hook-up, with 30 AMPs, a great plus and only steps away from the main house. If you stay around the house during the day, a deck runs the width of the house and is the perfect place for sun-worshipers.

Inside, you will be delighted with the high ceilings of the great room and all the carefully detailed wood accoutrements. This design allows everyone to come together as the meal is prepared, so no one will miss the chatter of the day’s events. Stainless steel appliances and plenty of counter space make it a perfect gathering place. The dining area has a large table, right off the living room that features two comfy sofas and a mounted flat-screen TV.

Beach access is also an advantage while staying at Seagrove Sanctuary. This home offers four beach chairs and a beach umbrella to enjoy while spending the day at the beach. Then, an outdoor shower refreshes you before you head inside. The detached laundry room and beach amenity storage are steps away from the main house.

This South Walton home off 30A is conveniently located near Publix, Seaside, and a UPS store for mailing cards that say “Wish you were here!” There’s also a nail salon, liquor store, and great shopping abounds at the Seaside Center, and countless unique boutiques. When eating out, your choices range from fast food to elegant dining establishments, and the seafood offerings are truly extraordinary. You’ll be delighted with the “catch of the day” choices, or better yet, go fishing and see all the Gulf “dishes up.” For your touring pleasure, you can also take advantage of golf carts or bicycle rentals to fully enjoy all this area has to offer.

Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 6):

- Primary Bedroom: One Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower
- Guest Bedroom: One Queen Bed
- Sleeper Sofa
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
